# The Researcher's Workspace (master plan, section 18, stage 2). Closed until the
# trial: not in the menu, not for search engines. The page talks to the server
# at api.populiverse.com (folder server/ of the repository). Signed out it shows
# the three doors; signed in it shows the shelf. On the editor's Mac the preview
# shows the pages, and says that sign-in works on populiverse.com.
# No title above the tabs (the row of 2026-11-13 on the mockup, point 6).
include-in-header:
  - text: '<meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow">'
resources:
  - workspace.js
  - write.js
---

<div id="ws-app" class="pv-ws-app" data-view="shelf">
